cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA991, you are just over CD at 6000m, ask Beijing Approach to transfer you to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是CCA991，飞机通过CD保持6000米，向北京进近请求移交至北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA991, 6000m maintaining, over CD, request change to Beijing Control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航991，保持6000米过CD，请求换频到北京区调。

cards.audioText: CCA991, climb to and maintain 6600m, contact Beijing Control 124.55.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，上升保持6600米，联系北京区调124.55。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600m, 124.55, CCA991.

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 6600m maintaining, request 10400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【与北京区调建立初次联系，6600米保持，请求上升到10400米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, 6600m maintaining. Request climb to 10400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，6600米保持，请求上升到10400米。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control. Initial climb to and maintain 8400m, standby for higher due to traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调。起始上升保持8400米，由于活动稍等更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Initial climb to and maintain 8400m, standing by, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初始爬升并保持8400米，稍等，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have an indication of weather about 40km ahead of you, request turn right heading 240.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管控员你前方40千米有天气显示，请求右转航向240。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991. We have an indication of bad weather about 40km ahead of us, request turn right heading 240.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，我们前方40千米有恶劣天气，请求右转航向240。

cards.audioText: CCA991, how many miles do you need to deviate from the weather?[You need 50-70 miles to deviate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，你需要偏航多少海里绕飞天气？【你需要偏航50到70海里。】
cards.referenceText: Request deviation 50 to 70 miles, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求偏航50到70海里，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, standby, we will ask the Air Force.[Hurry up, otherwise you will enter CBs.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，稍等，我们会询问空军。【要赶快，否则将会飞入积雨云。】
cards.referenceText: Request expedite, we are near the CBs, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求加快，我们接近积雨云了，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, deviation approved. Turn right heading 240 to deviate, no more than 80 miles, report change heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，同意偏航。右转航向240，偏航不要超过80海里，航向有变化报告。
cards.referenceText: Deviation approved, turn right heading 240 to deviate, no more than 80 miles, report change heading, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意偏航，右转航向240，偏航不超过80海里，航向有变化报告，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have cleared of CB and request direct to WXI.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你已远离积雨云，请求直飞WXI。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, cleared of weather, request direct to WXI.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，天气没影响，请求直飞WXI。

cards.audioText: CCA991, negative due to Air Force restriction. Resume course as soon as able.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，由于空军限制区不可以，尽快归航。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, resuming course, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，归航，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller you are on course at 10400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员你在10400米归航。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, course resumed at 10400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，10400米归航。

cards.audioText: [You find smoke coming from engine bleed air system. Declare urgency to ATC, request lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现发动机引气系统有烟冒出，向ATC宣布紧急，请求更低高度。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CCA991, smoke is coming from engine bleed system, request lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，国航991，发动机引气系统有烟冒出，请求更低高度。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control, roger PANPAN, descend to and maintain 6900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持6900米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6900m, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持6900米，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control. Report situation.[Tell the controller that you suspect something is on fire, you try to find the exact location of the fire, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调。报告情况。【告诉管制员你怀疑机上起火，你试图找出起火的准确位置，请求返回北京机场并优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: We suspect something is on fire, we are trying to locate the source now. Request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疑似起火，我们正在定位火源，请求返回北京机场优先着陆，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, if able turn left heading 360, descend to and maintain 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，如可能左转航向360，下降保持6300米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 360, descend to and maintain 6300m, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向360，下降保持6300米，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, descend to and maintain 5100m. Contact Beijing Approach 120.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，下降保持5100米。联系北京进近120.6。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 5100m, 120.6, CCA991.

cards.audioText: [Make a distress call for Beijing Approach, report engine fire, request landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向北京进近发出遇险信号，报告发动机起火情况，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, CCA991, engine fire, request expedite landing clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京进近，国航991，发动机起火，请求紧急着陆许可。

cards.audioText: CCA991, roger, descend to and maintain 1800m on QNH 1012, information D, expect ILS approach runway 18R, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，收到，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，通播D，预计跑道18右盲降进近，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 1800m on QNH 1012, information D, ILS runway 18R, number one, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，通播D，跑道18右盲降进近，第一个，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have open flames in the cargo compartment and rear cabin. Several passengers are hurt, request medical and fire services on landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员飞机货舱和客舱后部有明火，几位乘客受伤，请求着陆后提供医疗和消防服务。】
cards.referenceText: (Mayday Mayday, mayday) Beijing Approach, CCA991. Request medical and fire services on landing. We have open flames in the cargo compartment and rear cabin. Several passengers are hurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: （Mayday Mayday, mayday）北京进近，国航991。请求着陆后医疗和消防服务，货舱和客舱后部有明火，几位乘客受伤。

cards.audioText: CCA991, roger. Airport emergency services will be notified.[You have fully established on the ILS runway 18R, call Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，收到，将通知机场紧急服务。【你已完全建立跑道18右盲降，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA991, ILS established runway 18R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航991，建立盲降，跑道18右。

cards.audioText: CCA991, continue approach and contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，继续进近，联系塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.1, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.1，国航991。
